story_overview: In Nexus Plaza, an energy vortex transforms Anya and Ethan into armored soldiers, joining Nikolai and Javier. Chaos ensues as Cruz attacks Nikolai, and massive behemoths and missiles ravage the city. From an office, Leo investigates the crisis, which leads him, Nikolai, and Cruz to a hospital filled with affected patients.

video_prompts:
Nikolai: Man with a haggard face and unruly, matted dark hair, wearing a disheveled and dirt-stained black suit over an unbuttoned white shirt with a loose, askew white cravat.
Kai: Person wearing a light-colored trench coat, a red bandana, and a bow tie.
The Medical Bay: Interior of a stark hospital or laboratory room containing a bed and a doorway.
the beige tactical vest: Beige tactical vest with multiple storage pouches, MOLLE webbing, and adjustable straps with black plastic buckles.
the camouflage tactical vest: Tactical vest with a beige camouflage pattern.
the green exosuit: Full-body suit of robotic futuristic armor composed of interlocking green and black plates forming a complete exoskeleton.

Medium shot in The Medical Bay, with the green hooded jacket visible. Nikolai, wearing the camouflage tactical vest, and Kai, wearing the beige tactical vest, stand in profile, the black ink tattoo visible on Kai's neck. They both slowly turn their heads to look intently off-screen to the right. Behind them, several figures in the green exosuit stand partially visible against a plain white wall.

video_prompts:
Anya: Woman with shoulder-length dark hair.
Ethan: Man with shaggy brown hair wearing a tan collared jacket.
Javier: Man wearing a red bandana and a long dark skirt with white stripes at the hem.

the swirling energy vortex: A swirling, glowing mass of fiery green and black energy.
Orion: Person in futuristic armor with a glowing helmet

In the urban plaza of Nexus Plaza, Anya and Ethan are suddenly enveloped by the swirling energy vortex. Their civilian clothes instantly transform into matching green exosuits. Now armored, they join Javier and Orion as they all fall into a soldier formation.

Cruz: Man wearing a red bandana, a green shirt, and camouflage pants.
the massive video wall: A bank of large, rectangular, illuminated digital display screens forming a massive video wall.

In the daytime chaos of Nexus Plaza, Cruz lunges forward, throwing a punch, as Orion looks on. On a building in the background, the massive video wall displays a man's face.

Silas: Man with a smudged face and a fake beard, wearing a yellow beanie, a light grey quilted vest over a blue long-sleeved shirt, and a brown jacket.

Over-the-shoulder shot on a chaotic street in Nexus Plaza during the day. A figure in the green exosuit forcefully pushes Kai. In the background, other armored soldiers and frightened civilians, including Orion, Javier, Silas, and Cruz, react with alarm.

Leo: Man with a clean-shaven face and neatly-combed dark hair, wearing a rumpled grey business suit with a loosened tie and an open-collared blue dress shirt.
Academy Courtyard: An outdoor school courtyard with an adjacent large building.

In the daytime at Academy Courtyard, Nikolai stands defensively, facing two massive armored behemoths that tower over the group. Behind him, Leo, Anya, Cruz, and Orion flinch as both behemoths raise their arms, unleashing a swirling energy vortex which fills the air with thick smoke and bright sparks.

the military missiles: Long, cylindrical military missiles with a sleek, gunmetal-grey metallic finish, a sharply pointed nose cone, and multiple stabilizing fins at the base.

Large, fiery explosions erupt between the buildings, sending up thick plumes of black smoke as the swirling energy vortex moves through the destruction.
